additional_info.subject: RE: ID0376230-DC/Si-D/FI-[nFJBZS]- SiCharger_PLC_CPU_KF1 after v5.0.19 CRM:00645000737
additional_info.body:
Dear Sakari,
I hope all is well with you. As the charger is working fine now and the issue is already addressed by FW v 5.0.21, which is going to be released by CW 38, I am proceeding to close the ticket. Please be aware that this issue can be temporarily resolved by rebooting the PLC part of the charger via SSH. So in case you observe the same issue, please raise a ticket to get the support.
In case this error becomes severe and affects the charger operation, please plan to downgrade the charger by either Cfast card flashing or request remote support to roll back the previous FW.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
